name: pm-tech-product
description: Requirements and delivery rigor for technology/IT product PMs: PRD writing, requirement analysis, state machines, acceptance criteria, user stories, sprint planning and retrospectives, structured brainstorming, business process modeling, business rules, technical impact analysis, security review, QA test-scenario generation, release go/no-go gating, access control, audit logging, cross-system data consistency, and PMBOK-grounded scope/schedule/risk/change management.
